Name: Maplestory Shinjou for Adopt 'n' Skin
Author: kooruxi
Description:
[font=Georgia]♡ ﻿A horse reskin pack for Adopt 'n' Skin! Your divine companion, Shinjou, awaits. ♡
Shinjou is a mount from Maplestory, but even if you're not familiar, it's a lovely fantasy addition to your farm!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/4oELxw1.png[/img]﻿
╭
┆  ﻿• Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]Adopt 'n' Skin[/url]
﻿┆ 
┆  • Rename and place your Shinjou.png into the [size=2]/assets/skins[/size] folder of Adopt'n'Skin.
﻿┆    All horse files should be named [size=2]Horse_[Skin ID][/size], with the [size=2][Skin ID][/size] being a unique number over 1.
┆    So, Shinjou.png would be renamed to something like Horse_6.png - whatever ID# you gave it.
﻿┆
﻿┆  • Find the console commands [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4011]here[/url] to see additional instructions for using Adopt 'n' Skin!
╰

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bAlIS6E.png[/img]
╭
┆  • If you have any questions or concerns, reach out on Discord to username "kooru." 
┆
┆  • Feel free to convert Shinjou however you want without asking for permission, just let me know and remember to cred.
┆
┆  • Sprites from ManaKirel's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4697]Vintage Interface v2[/url] were used in my images! 
┆    I was too lazy to list out the other mods seen in the preview, but let me know if you're curious and I can post them. :3
╰[/font]
